alerts.title: Ice, yellow level, Lowland areas and valleys in southeastern Norway, 2026-11-06T15:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-09T10:00:00+00:00
alerts.area: Lowland areas and valleys in southeastern Norway
alerts.description: There is risk of glaze ice, due to widespread freezing fog and occasional freezing drizzle. The fog and drizzle is freezing on the ground, as well as on vehicles and other objects. In the middle of the day Saturday and Sunday there may locally be less fog, the temperature may locally be above freezing point, and the danger may thus decrease temporarily.
alerts.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Allow extra time for travel and driving. Use correct tires and drive according to the conditions. Follow the updates: Stay updated on weather warnings. Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk.

alerts.title: Heavy rain, yellow level, Parts of Troms and Nordland, 2026-11-08T03:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-09T12:00:00+00:00
alerts.description:
A lot of rain is expected from Sunday morning to late Monday morning, locally around 40-50 mm during 24 hours. 

Sunday morning there has already fallen 50-80 mm in the last 48 hours. 

Monday afternoon transitioning to snow- and sleet showers.
alerts.instruction: Flooding may occur: Consider clearing drains and gutters so water can flow away. Difficult driving conditions: Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk. Adjust your speed and drive according to the conditions. Be cautious in areas affected by flooding: Avoid going into deep water. Flooding and landslides: Check warnings at Varsom.no.

alerts.title: Gale, yellow level, Hekkingen - Torsvaag, 2026-11-08T15:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-09T09:00:00+00:00
alerts.description: From Sunday afternoon southwesterly near gale force 7, first in the south. Sunday evening increasing to southwesterly gale force 8.
